allow.zh:
alias: 今天到期的待辦提醒
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "08:00:00"
actions:
  - action: todo.get_items
    target:
      entity_id: todo.family_chores
    data:
      status: needs_action
    response_variable: result
  - variables:
      today: "{{ now().date() | string }}"
      due_today: >-
        {{ result['todo.family_chores']['items']
           | selectattr('due', 'defined')
           | rejectattr('due', 'none')
           | selectattr('due', 'search', today)
           | map(attribute='summary') | list }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ due_today | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: notify.mobile_app_my_phone
        data:
          title: 今天有 {{ due_today | count }} 件事到期
          message: "{{ due_today | join('、') }}"
mode: single

allow.zh:
template:
  - sensor:
      - name: "太陽能自發自用率"
        unique_id: solar_self_consumption_ratio
        unit_of_measurement: "%"
        state_class: measurement
        availability: >
          {{ is_number(states('sensor.solar_production_monthly'))
             and is_number(states('sensor.grid_export_monthly'))
             and states('sensor.solar_production_monthly') | float(0) > 0 }}
        state: >
          {% set gen = states('sensor.solar_production_monthly') | float(0) %}
          {% set exp = states('sensor.grid_export_monthly') | float(0) %}
          {{ ((gen - exp) / gen * 100) | round(1) }}

washer-notify/
├── SKILL.md          ← 唯一必要檔案
└── references/       ← 選用附件（AI 用到才讀）
    └── ha-service-map.md

# SKILL.md 內容
---
name: washer-notify
description: |
  當使用者問「洗衣機洗完了嗎」「該收衣服了嗎」，或提到
  自動化洗衣機提醒時觸發。可透過 HA API 讀取
  sensor.washer_power 判斷是否處於運轉/待機/完成狀態。
license: MIT
compatibility:
  agents: [claude-code, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
  mcp: [ha-mcp-woow, home-assistant/mcp-server]
allowed-tools: [ha_get_state, ha_get_history, notify_send]
---

# 洗衣機提醒 skill

當使用者提到洗衣機時，先讀 sensor.washer_power 過去 15 分鐘的
歷史：如果從 >100W 掉到 <5W 並持續 3 分鐘以上，回覆「洗完了」；
還在運轉則回覆預估剩餘時間（依平均運轉 45 分鐘估算）。

若使用者要求自動提醒，用 ha_config_set_automation 建一條：
trigger: sensor.washer_power < 5W 持續 3 分鐘
action: notify.mobile_app_myphone
先給使用者 YAML 摘要，同意再套用。
allow.en:
washer-notify/
├── SKILL.md          ← The only required file
└── references/       ← Optional supporting files (read by the AI only when needed)
    └── ha-service-map.md

# SKILL.md content
---
name: washer-notify
description: |
  Use this skill when the user asks whether the washing machine has finished,
  whether it is time to collect the laundry, or requests an automated laundry
  reminder. Read sensor.washer_power through the HA API to determine whether
  the machine is running, idle, or finished.
license: MIT
compatibility:
  agents: [claude-code, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
  mcp: [ha-mcp-woow, home-assistant/mcp-server]
allowed-tools: [ha_get_state, ha_get_history, notify_send]
---

# Laundry reminder skill

When the user mentions the washing machine, first read the past 15 minutes of
history for sensor.washer_power. If power falls from >100W to <5W and remains
there for at least 3 minutes, reply that the cycle is complete. If the machine
is still running, estimate the time remaining from an average 45-minute cycle.

If the user requests an automatic reminder, use ha_config_set_automation to create one:
trigger: sensor.washer_power < 5W for 3 minutes
action: notify.mobile_app_myphone
Show the user a YAML summary and obtain approval before applying it.
